author: Cptnwhizbang
body: Spam kingdom raids and boss.horde dungeons. At T8, boss gauntlets are a net positive on keys, unless you get a ton of event mobs that don't drop keys. Raiding will be your best route though.

author: WhichOstrich
body: In monuments I'm getting a level in ~45 minutes right now at the same level bracket. Pop an XP pot and kill event bosses when they're there, otherwise just push floors fast. 8m per floor adds up quick.

author: NicodemusArcleon
body: Are you in a kingdom? Most players will allow you to "tag along" in a group, and get some of the shared XP. If not, you can get someone within 25 levels of you to do the same. I have an alt that I am also bringing up solo, as he's too far below my main. If you want to join up and such, my IGN is Nico Arcleon (currently level 173).

author: Anthonevil
body: Build the fishing guild. Do the fishing mini game a ton and sell the fish to the fishing guild. Buy a ton of summoning scrolls from the fishing guild. Use the summoning scrolls to spawn raid bosses. Keep attacking them until you kill the raid bosse. Other than that, I'm not a summoner so I'm not sure if the monoceros is what you should be using. Join the orna discord and people can help you with your build.

author: AggressiveSorbett
body: i don't know if it was already said, but monuments are always underrated. like world farming they give more EXP unlike dungeon mobs. just make sure to stack EXP boosters, whether it be gears or consumables. oh and target bosses, especially event ones as a general guide. do note that riftfall bosses do give more EXP than usual.

author: TenkenL
body: Ive only played solo, im lv190 now but ive jumped from 179 to 190 in 2 days, all i did was summon bunch of raid bosses and i basically solod them, and i try to get many down to super low hp then switch to exp gear and shrine of xp and xp pot, and then kill the bosses. Generally at lv190 it takes about 2 raid bosses per lvl now, so its not too bad, im running summoner class. Hope that helps

author: Anthonevil
body: Definitely build & Try all the guilds. But in my opinion the fishing is the easiest way to get a ton of summoning scrolls with minimal effort. Kingdom raids are good. But the exp you get is directly proportional to the amount of damage you do to the raid. So solo-ing your own raids is going to get you way more exp.
